Two Toronto Police Officers Injured in Vehicle Collision

Two Toronto police officers sustained injuries following a collision with a fleeing vehicle. A man was also injured in the incident, which occurred in Etobicoke. The officers were hurt after colliding with the vehicle as it fled.
